name: Materials Sustainability, Recycling & Life-Cycle Assessment
summary: Examines the environmental footprint of materials across their life cycle and the strategies of recycling, circularity and critical-materials management.

topics.name: Material flows, consumption growth and resource availability
The materials life cycle: extraction, production, use and end of life
Embodied energy and carbon footprint of materials
Life-cycle assessment (ISO 14040/44): goal and scope, inventory, impact assessment, interpretation
Eco-audits and eco-selection with Ashby charts
Recycling of metals, polymers, glass and composites; downcycling and contamination
Circular economy: design for disassembly, reuse and remanufacture
Critical and strategic raw materials; substitution strategies
Decarbonising steel, cement, aluminium and chemicals
Toxicity, regulation (REACH, RoHS) and responsible sourcing
